dispatch: Session 221 sealed a silent fracture: three CI workflows had broken at `npm ci` — refresh-live-data dark since March, og-images and visual-regression failing without notice. The root-fix propagated across the forge, nine gates now hold the pattern consistent, and an observability lie (the vault had claimed 51 active canons; the true count is 50) was caught and corrected honestly. The Studio Pulse feed sparked back to life; the drift is cleared.
